activate_my_card: The customer wants to activate a card they have received.
age_limit: The customer asks about the minimum age required to open or use an account.
apple_pay_or_google_pay: The customer asks about using Apple Pay or Google Pay with their card.
atm_support: The customer asks which ATMs they can use or how to use their card at an ATM.
automatic_top_up: The customer asks about setting up or using automatic top-ups of their account.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: The customer transferred money into their account, but their balance has not been updated.
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: The customer deposited a cheque or cash, but their balance has not changed.
beneficiary_not_allowed: The customer is blocked from adding a beneficiary or sending money to one.
cancel_transfer: The customer wants to cancel or stop a transfer they have made.
card_about_to_expire: The customer's card is about to expire and they ask about a replacement.
card_acceptance: The customer asks where or by which merchants their card is accepted.
card_arrival: The customer ordered a card and it still has not arrived.
card_delivery_estimate: The customer asks how long card delivery usually takes.
card_linking: The customer wants to link a card to their account or app.
card_not_working: The customer's card does not work when they try to use it.
card_payment_fee_charged: The customer was charged an extra fee for paying by card.
card_payment_not_recognised: The customer sees a card payment they do not recognise.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: The customer thinks a wrong exchange rate was applied to a card payment.
card_swallowed: An ATM kept or swallowed the customer's card.
cash_withdrawal_charge: The customer was charged a fee for withdrawing cash.
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: The customer sees a cash withdrawal they did not make.
change_pin: The customer wants to change their card PIN.
compromised_card: The customer thinks their card details have been compromised or used by someone else.
contactless_not_working: Contactless payments with the customer's card do not work.
country_support: The customer asks which countries the service is available in.
declined_card_payment: A card payment the customer tried to make was declined.
declined_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal the customer tried to make was declined.
declined_transfer: A transfer the customer tried to make was rejected.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: The customer sees a direct debit payment they do not recognise.
disposable_card_limits: The customer asks about limits on disposable virtual cards.
edit_personal_details: The customer wants to change personal details such as their name, address or phone number.
exchange_charge: The customer asks about or was charged a fee for currency exchange.
exchange_rate: The customer asks what exchange rate is used for currency conversion.
exchange_via_app: The customer wants to exchange currency using the app.
extra_charge_on_statement: The customer sees an unexpected extra charge on their statement.
failed_transfer: A transfer the customer made did not complete because of an error.
fiat_currency_support: The customer asks whether traditional (fiat) currencies such as euros or dollars are supported.
get_disposable_virtual_card: The customer wants to get a disposable virtual card.
get_physical_card: The customer wants to get a physical card.
getting_spare_card: The customer wants an additional or spare card.
getting_virtual_card: The customer wants to get a regular (non-disposable) virtual card.
lost_or_stolen_card: The customer's card has been lost or stolen.
lost_or_stolen_phone: The customer's phone with the banking app has been lost or stolen.
order_physical_card: The customer wants to order a physical card.
passcode_forgotten: The customer forgot their app passcode and cannot log in.
pending_card_payment: A card payment the customer made is still shown as pending.
pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal the customer made is still shown as pending.
pending_top_up: A top-up the customer made is still shown as pending.
pending_transfer: A transfer the customer made is still shown as pending.
pin_blocked: The customer's PIN has been blocked, for example after too many wrong attempts.
receiving_money: The customer asks how other people can send money to them.
Refund_not_showing_up: The customer is expecting a refund, but it has not appeared in their account yet.
request_refund: The customer wants to request a refund for a purchase.
reverted_card_payment?: A card payment the customer made was reverted or returned to their account.
supported_cards_and_currencies: The customer asks which card types and currencies the service supports.
terminate_account: The customer wants to close their account.
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: The customer asks about or was charged a fee for topping up by bank transfer.
top_up_by_card_charge: The customer asks about or was charged a fee for topping up by card.
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: The customer wants to top up their account with cash or a cheque.
top_up_failed: A top-up the customer tried to make failed.
top_up_limits: The customer asks about limits on how much they can top up.
top_up_reverted: A top-up the customer made was reverted or cancelled.
topping_up_by_card: The customer wants to top up their account using a card.
transaction_charged_twice: The customer was charged twice for the same transaction.
transfer_fee_charged: The customer was charged a fee for a transfer.
transfer_into_account: The customer wants to move money into their account from another account of theirs.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The customer sent a transfer but the recipient has not received it.
transfer_timing: The customer asks how long a transfer takes to arrive.
unable_to_verify_identity: The customer is trying to verify their identity but the verification fails.
verify_my_identity: The customer asks how to verify their identity.
verify_source_of_funds: The customer is asked to prove or verify the source of their funds.
verify_top_up: The customer asks why or how they need to verify a top-up.
virtual_card_not_working: The customer's virtual card does not work.
visa_or_mastercard: The customer asks whether their card is Visa or Mastercard.
why_verify_identity: The customer asks why they need to verify their identity.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: An ATM gave the customer a different amount of cash than requested.
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: The customer thinks their cash withdrawal was converted at the wrong exchange rate.
